content: MK lists as an untitled work the Kitāb Ṣāʾin al-Dīn ʿAlī Turka in MS Add. 7611, ff. 85b-123b (British Library, copied 1137/1725), part of a Sufi compilation of extracts; given the compilation's theme he says examination may show it to be Ibn Turka's R. Aṭvār-i Salāsa or his Żawʾ al-Lamaʿāt, treatises popular with Sufi audiences.
